The '''Toxic Peko-peko''' was a creature raised and [[Mutant|mutated]] by the outlaw [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]]. He conducted experiments on [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko-pekos]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], hoping to create invincible creatures that would act as his protectors and mounts.

==Behind the scenes==
The Toxic Peko-peko is a [[:w:c:swg:Mount|mount]] that can be used by players of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It could be acquired via a "[[:w:c:swg:Loot card|loot card]]" from the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''{{'s}} expansion ''[[Agents of Deception]]''. This card could be redeemed for a copy of the mount in ''Star Wars Galaxies''.
